question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Causmetic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** incorrectly spelled** word is **1) Causmetic.**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Cosmetic."**
 
• **Cosmetic** refers to a product or substance used to enhance or beautify the appearance of the face, body, or hair. (सौंदर्यिक)
 
• **It includes** items such as makeup, skincare products, and fragrances.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Causmetic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **Turmeric:** Turmeric is a spice derived from the root of the Curcuma longa plant. It is commonly used as a culinary ingredient and has medicinal properties.(हल्दी)
 
• **Detergent: **Detergent refers to a substance or cleaning agent used for washing or cleaning. It is typically used for laundry, dishes, or other household cleaning purposes. ( डिटर्जेंट)
 
• **Playful:** Playful describes someone or something that is full of energy, joy, or a willingness to play. It refers to a lighthearted and fun-loving nature. ( खिलखिलाते)
